output.headline: Privia Health has bought twice in the target's own sub-sector, at $205M and $256M, and pays 20.5x, close to the comparable median.
output.differentiator: Both prior deals sit in the target's $150M-$600M size band and both closed. Its 20.5x median paid is below the median of every other strategic on the priority list.
output.why_them: Repeat Health IT buyer in the target's size band; pays near median

acquirer_overview.title: A Health IT strategic with a small but fully closed record
points: Strategic buyer with Health IT as its home sub-sector; annual revenue of $2,123M for the year ending 2025-12-31 [B:buyer, P:1].
Two deals from 2017 to 2024, both in the target's sub-sector, both closed (2 of 2, 100%) [T:record, K:closed_share].
Bought Evolent Health's accountable care business for $100M in cash plus up to $13M, closing 2025-12-05 [P:3].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Same-sub-sector buyer whose past deals were technology-led
points: Share of its deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor in its likelihood; margin fit and close rate are modest positives [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit, S:close_rate_s].
Technology Capability drove 2 of 2 deals, against 10% of all deals in the file, a distinctive motive [M:technology_capability].
Stated mandate is minority or majority ownership of provider groups or clinically integrated networks, so the target is a technology extension [P:2].

precedent_activity.title: Two Health IT deals of $205M and $256M, both closed
points: Keystone Population Health: $205M minority investment in 2024 at 20.2x EBITDA and 6.29x revenue [D:MA-2024-0128].
Select EHR Solutions: $256M SPAC merger in 2017 at 20.9x EBITDA and 5.94x revenue [D:MA-2017-0427].
Both deals fall in the $150M-$600M comparable size band; median deal is $231M [K:size_band, T:record].

valuation_context.title: Median anchor of 21.4x is defensible; Privia has room to pay
points: 13 same-sub-sector comparables show 19.4x at the lower quartile, 21.4x median and 23.3x at the upper quartile [V:comps].
Target margin of 25.0% is above the comps' 22.2% median but not in the top quarter, so the 50th percentile is the anchor [V:comps].
Privia's own median of 20.5x sits just under the comparable median. Cost synergy headroom is $14M-$23M against revenue of $2,123M [V:comps, V:synergy, P:1].

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: The $300M target exceeds its biggest deal of $256M.
risk_flags.mitigant: Revenue of $2,123M gives capacity beyond its prior cheques [P:1].
risk_flags.reality: Both precedents were $205M-$256M, so this is a step up [T:record, X:target].

risk_flags.title: Mandate focus
risk_flags.concern: Stated mandate targets provider groups, and past seller fit is a slight negative [P:2, S:own_fit_s].
risk_flags.mitigant: Both precedents were in the target's own sub-sector [K:by_sub_sector].
risk_flags.reality: Half its deals (1 of 2) were minority stakes, so control is untested [K:control_share].

risk_flags.title: Crowded process and no regional record
risk_flags.concern: Blackstone and Evolent Health also rate High, and Privia has no deal in the target's region [C:conviction, T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: Footprint covers 43 states and the District of Columbia [P:4].
risk_flags.reality: Ranked 5th on the priority list of 10 with a 3.8% likelihood [R:rank].

conviction.rationale: Two deals in the target's own sub-sector support the call, but no deal in the target's region keeps it neutral and the record is only two deals [C:conviction, T:record].
